items.title: Gangnam Style
items.line: Psy posted it on 15 July 2012. On 21 December it became the first YouTube video to reach a billion views.

items.title: London Olympics
items.line: Danny Boyle directed the opening ceremony on 27 July 2012. Team GB finished third with 65 medals, 29 of them gold, and Michael Phelps won his 22nd medal.

items.title: The Avengers
items.line: Joss Whedon's team-up opened in the US on 4 May 2012 and grossed about $1.52 billion worldwide.

items.title: The Hunger Games
items.line: Opened 23 March 2012 with $152.5 million in North America and ended near $695 million worldwide on a $78 million budget.

items.title: Curiosity lands on Mars
items.line: It touched down in Gale crater at 05:17 UTC on 6 August 2012, via a sky crane maneuver NASA called the Seven Minutes of Terror.

items.title: Skyfall
items.line: UK release 26 October 2012. It was the first Bond film past $1 billion, and Adele's theme was the first Bond theme to win an Oscar.

items.title: Obama re-elected
items.line: 6 November 2012. Obama beat Mitt Romney 332 to 206 in the Electoral College, 51.1 percent to 47.2 percent of the popular vote.
